setupHelp: Connect your Coolify instance with an API token that has read permission. The token only sees its own team and allowed resources.
keepToken: API token (leave blank to keep current)
privacy: Saved only on this computer with owner-only file permissions. Never stored in shell settings. Only HTTPS connections are accepted, except localhost.
stale: Showing the last known result. Data may be out of date.
pollHelp: Every 30 seconds; every 5 seconds while deploying.
notificationsHelp: Starts and results. Automatic detection requires background refresh.
errorUrl: Enter a valid Coolify URL without credentials, query or fragment.
errorHttps: Use HTTPS. Plain HTTP is allowed only on localhost.
errorToken: Enter a valid Coolify API token.
errorUnreachable: Cannot reach Coolify. Check the URL, network and TLS certificate.
errorAccess: Access denied. Check the token's read permission, team and API access.
errorResponse: Unexpected Coolify response. Check the instance URL and API version.
errorTooMany: More than 200 applications; narrow the API token's scope.
errorTooLarge: Coolify returned more data than the plugin reads (4 MiB per response, 16 MiB per refresh); narrow the API token's scope.
errorRedirect: Coolify answered with a redirect. Enter the final instance URL; the token is never sent to a redirect target.
errorSave: Could not save the connection file.
warnFilter: Some watched application UUIDs are not visible to this token.
